The agency's work began in earnest in 1951 after a significant infusion of financial and technical resources.  The WHO's official mandate is to promote health and safety while helping the vulnerable worldwide. World Health Organization.fact: The agency's work began in earnest in 1951 after a significant infusion of financial and technical resources.  The WHO's official mandate is to promote health and safety while helping the vulnerable worldwide.  It provides technical assistance to countries, sets international health standards, collects data on global health issues, and serves as a forum for scientific or policy discussions related to health.  Its official publication, the World Health Report, provides assessments of worldwide health topics.
